about: Policy rule P4 time budgets (milestone 0014 Story 02.0 Task 03). budget_minutes = ceil(2 x the slowest leg's median duration / 60), from the Story 01.0 Task 01 baseline: median of the last 5 green master runs of ci.yml, recorded in docs/roadmap/0014-ci-rework-from-scratch/status.md (2026-11-12). The gate recomputes budget_minutes from median_s. A job not listed here gets default_job_minutes. A step's timeout may not exceed its job's timeout; 'steps' may set a tighter per-step budget keyed '<job>/<step id>'. Table: docs/dev/ci.md. Per-step budgets (Story 03.0 Task 01) are first estimates, not baselines (no per-step median exists yet): every one is at most its job budget, and Story 03.0 Task 04 replaces them with measured values. The 'gui' baseline is the old ci.yml 'gui-build' job's (Story 03.0 Task 03 renamed the job).
